Chiara Martinez: Quick ask — for next Wed's webinar 'Scaling LLMs in Prod' we need a 6-post X/LinkedIn sequence + short community snippets to drive live Q&A. Also need an inbound lead routing + engagement follow-up plan.
Alex Li: OK — propose cadence: teaser (Mon), speaker clip (Tue), countdown (Wed morning), live clip (during), highlight (Thu), CTA thread (Fri).
Sam Patel: I can pull 3x 15s clips from the recording and make two quote cards. Who owns speaker approval?
Chiara Martinez: @Jordan Rivera will you own speaker approval + timings?
Jordan Rivera: Yep, I'll ping speakers today. Recommendation: tag personas #platform #ml-eng. For UTMs use `?utm_source=x&utm_campaign=webinar_scale`.
marketing-bot: Reminder — post scheduling slots open in Buffer: https://app.buffer.com/redwood
Alex Li: Assets needed by EOD Tue: 3 clips, 2 quote cards, short abstract (<=280 chars), 1 PNG for LinkedIn header.
Sam Patel: I'll upload to /marketing/assets/webinars/scale-llm by Tue noon. @Chiara can you draft the 280-char abstract?
Chiara Martinez: Draft below: 'Join us Wed to hear how teams reduced inference costs by 3x while keeping latency SLOs — real-world playbook + live Q&A.' Thoughts?
Alex Li: Nice — small tweak: call out speakers. Final: 'Join us Wed to hear how @Priya and @Noah reduced inference cost 3x while keeping latency SLOs — real-world playbook + live Q&A.'
Jordan Rivera: Inbound leads: route to SDR queue 'webinar-scale' via HubSpot form webhook. @Sam can you confirm form is linked and webhook live? Also set automated follow-up email 1hr after sign-up.
Sam Patel: Form wired, webhook tested. I'll create HubSpot list + notify #sales-inbound webhook. Sample follow-up copy: 'Thanks for registering! We'll send the calendar link + recording (after live).'
Chiara Martinez: Engagement play: 1) pinned comment during live with poll link; 2) 24hr post — 'key takeaways' thread + clip; 3) 72hr — SDR personalized outreach for MQLs.
Alex Li: :thumbsup: I'll set Buffer schedule and Slack reminders. Who wants to monitor live mentions and audience Qs? @Jordan?
Jordan Rivera: I'll monitor live; @Sam will triage leads and hand off to sales.
marketing-bot: Scheduled reminder created for Wed 09:00 PT in #marketing.
Chiara Martinez: Thanks all — pushing timelines. If anyone needs extra creative or copy tweaks, ping me here or DM.
